out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink being used TO STACK CLEANED TRAYS
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Trays removed from handsink basin.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: BOWLS, PLATES, TRAYS OBSERVED WASHED WITH SOAP AND WATER AND PLACED TO DRY.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS ASSISTED EMPLOYEE IN MAKING SANITIZER BASIN IN 3 COMP SINK TO ADEQUATELY SANITIZE EQUIPMENT.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: portioned rice observed at 129F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Rice to be used or discarded by 3pm.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Bean Sprouts (55F) over- stacked in 2 Dr prep rail.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Bean sprouts to be used or discarded by 3pm.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: Cooling items placed into 2Dr UCR holding an ambient temp of 50F.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS discussed to have repair to cooler to hold at lower temp.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: Observed hair in container of fish cakes in 1Dr prep.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. Fish cakes discarded

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed boxes of cabbages, carrots, onions on floor of establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers for Garlic were observed reused for the storage of EVERYTHING.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS discussed container usage with PIC.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2DR UCR unit across from cookline observed at 50F. PIC stated temperature is increased due to contestant usage and proximity to cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS recommended temperature in unit be adjusted to ensure food items can hold at 41F or below

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Cooked Kimchi (45F) and cooked bean sprouts (45F) observed in 2 Dr UCR. Tofu (70F) and bean sprouts (73F) observed in ambient at cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 Dr UCR observed at 50F. PIC stated the unit was used a lot during lunch rush.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. -Please monitor unit to ensure temperature is maintained. Obtain service if needed.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The ONLY handwashing facility in the establishment is blocked with serving trays, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. Serving trays removed from hand sink basin.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: Soup bowl observed washed with soap and water and returned to cookline to be used.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS discussed with manager that all food contact surfaces must be sanitized at least once every 4 hours.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: Knives observed stored between the prep units soiled with food bits.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. Knives taken to sink to be washed rinsed and sanitized.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Cut tofu (50F) observed stacked above food items in prep rail.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Tofu moved to underside of unit to maintain temperature.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the Chlorine sanitizer solution was measured above 200 ppm in the wiping cloth bucket. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of chlorine solution at 50-100ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. Water added to wiping cloth bucket, observed at 100 ppm.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers of peeled garlic were observed reused for the storage of kimchi, sauces, various food items.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: wooden spoons observed splitting along food contact surface.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. Obtain new spoons.
